summary: Maris-Tech Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated June 1, 2026, announcing the development of Venus-Space, an AI-powered edge video solution for low earth orbit nano satellites. This is a routine product launch announcement with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or capital return. The filing does not involve any merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or management change. As a foreign private issuer's report of ordinary business operations, the filing is classified as None under the special-situations framework.
